notes: Item 19 discloses annual Gross Revenues for calendar year 2024 for 32 franchised leased locations (30 US + 2 UK) open at least one full calendar year as of December 31, 2024. Data is broken out by: (1) square footage tiers, (2) individual location KPI table with aggregate averages/medians, and (3) network-wide system gross revenue by year 2019-2024. The Greenville, SC revenue value had an OCR space artifact ('$1, 380,126') which was normalized to 1380126. Peak Occupancy and Average Leads/Mo are operational metrics (not financial revenue metrics) and are included as 'other' metric type. Two UK locations (London Chiswick Park, London White City) are included in the cohort; values are reported in USD per the document.
